audience: IoT and edge teams that run device fleets on balenaCloud

useCases.title: Find devices that are offline
useCases.text: List the applications the key can access. Then list the devices of one application that are offline.

useCases.title: Check the health of one device
useCases.text: Read a device by its uuid. Then read its online state, overall status, last connectivity event, CPU, memory and storage.

useCases.title: Find the release with a commit
useCases.text: List the releases of one application, optionally by commit hash. Open one release to read its status and whether it is invalidated.

useCases.title: Rename a device or set its note
useCases.text: Set the display name of a device, or replace its note with an owner or location reminder. Neither change touches the running software.

useCases.title: Confirm which account a key acts for
useCases.text: Check the account behind the API key first. Then list the applications it can access.
